text:
This is the season Cole Perfetti's role finally caught up with his draft slot. The 10th pick of 2020 is playing 18:08 a night, up from 15:37, and he's been on the ice for 91% of Winnipeg's power-play chances after 50% last season. The result is 20 points in 23 games, 10 of them on the power play, and our numbers rank him 22nd of 548 skaters in wins added.

The best part is that the chances came with the role. His own expected goals (the quality of his shots) are up to 1.52 per 60 from 1.08, and his 9 goals actually trail the 10.5 his looks were worth. Nothing about the scoring looks borrowed.

TSN ran the headline "Arniel happy Mercer and Perfetti's chemistry is helping provide needed secondary scoring," and the Jets need it. The one thing to watch: his minutes over the last ten games dipped to 17:20. Our talent range puts him around 2.1 points per 60 over time, below his current 2.88, so some regression in the rate is normal even if the role sticks.
